creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-09 on 0.24.0. An agent posted a short thanks (#7) to a finished helper, then closed the helper's pane with `muster pane close` straight away. Two minutes later @muster woke the agent with: "unicorn (p2jdn1e5mv) has not read #7, from mint (p2jdckxq5n), 2 minutes after it was posted: no agent is in its pane any more." The sender had closed that pane itself, so the notice told it nothing it did not know and cost it a turn.

Possibly: send no unread notice for a pane closed by `pane close`, at least when the sender or the pane's maker closed it, as opposed to a pane whose agent exited.
title: An unread notice for a pane its sender closed on purpose
